whatChanged.categoryZh: AI / 零售 / 智能体购物
whatChanged.headline: Walmart Wants AI Agents to Shop for You. Who Controls the Checkout?
whatChanged.headlineZh: 沃尔玛欢迎 AI 替你购物，但谁有权按下付款键？
intro: Imagine asking an AI assistant to restock your kitchen. It finds your usual milk and bread, then places the order. Convenient—until it buys something you never asked for. On October 21, Walmart announced a new way for outside AI agents to shop at Walmart and Sam’s Club, with separate permissions for each agent.
introZh: 想象一下：你让 AI 助手补货，它找到你常买的牛奶和面包，顺手下单。方便是方便，但如果它买了你没让它买的东西呢？10 月 21 日，沃尔玛宣布一套让外部 AI 智能体在 Walmart 和 Sam’s Club 购物的新机制，重点是给每个智能体单独设置权限。

sections.heading: How can shoppers control each AI agent?
sections.headingZh: 用户怎么管理每个购物 AI？
paragraphs: Walmart's planned Agent Profiles will show which purchases an AI agent made, separately from the customer's own orders. Shoppers will be able to require approval for each purchase or set a spending limit, and revoke an agent's access. Walmart says its rules require approval by default, and it may request extra approval even within a limit. Under Walmart's terms, agents cannot add or change payment methods or receive customers' payment-card details.
paragraphsZh: 沃尔玛计划推出 Agent Profiles，让用户分清哪些订单是自己下的，哪些是 AI 智能体下的。用户可以要求每笔订单都先确认，也可以设定消费上限，并随时撤销授权。沃尔玛表示，默认规则是购买前需要用户批准；即使订单在限额内，平台也可能要求额外确认。按照沃尔玛公布的条款，智能体不能添加或修改付款方式，也不会收到用户的银行卡资料。

sections.heading: How can agents shop without clicking through a website?
sections.headingZh: AI 不用点网页，怎么直接购物？
paragraphs: The Walmart Agent Gateway is intended to connect approved AI assistants directly to shopping systems, rather than making them navigate a website designed for people. Walmart describes it as an MCP-based connection—a standard way for software assistants to use outside tools. The company says the gateway could help an agent find a customer's usual products without revealing the full shopping history to the agent. That is Walmart's design claim, not an independently tested privacy guarantee.
paragraphsZh: 另一个工具叫 Walmart Agent Gateway。它计划让获准接入的 AI 助手通过 MCP 连接购物系统。简单说，MCP 是让 AI 调用外部工具的一种标准接口，不必像人一样逐页点击网站。沃尔玛称，系统还可以帮 AI 找到用户常买的商品，而不把完整购物记录交给 AI。这是沃尔玛对产品设计的说明，不能直接当成已经过独立验证的隐私保障。

sections.heading: What works today—and what is still coming?
sections.headingZh: 哪些已经能用，哪些还要等？
paragraphs: Walmart announced the tools on October 21, 2026. Its Agent Gateway is an early, invitation-only beta for developers and companies; Walmart says Agent Profiles are planned for the coming month, but has not given a firm launch date. This is not yet a service that every shopper can use in full. Walmart also says its ordinary returns process applies if an agent acts unexpectedly. TechCrunch reports that Amazon has restricted some third-party shopping agents, in contrast to Walmart's approach.
paragraphsZh: 这些功能于 2026 年 10 月 21 日公布。Agent Gateway 目前是面向企业和开发者、需要邀请的早期测试；沃尔玛表示，Agent Profiles 计划在接下来一个月推出，但尚未公布确切日期。普通用户还不能把整套功能当成已经全面上线。沃尔玛还表示，如果 AI 买错东西，仍适用其通常的退货流程。与此同时，据 TechCrunch 报道，亚马逊对部分第三方购物智能体采取了限制措施，两家零售商选择了不同的开放程度。

whatChanged.ending: A useful shopping agent needs more than a good recommendation. It needs permission to act—and limits on that permission.
whatChanged.endingZh: 能帮你挑东西的 AI 不难想象；真正关键的是，它什么时候可以替你付款，又在哪里必须停下来问你。

stayCurious.categoryZh: 新加坡 / 野生动物 / 科学
stayCurious.headline: Singapore Has a “Crab” With Blue Blood. Why Does Medicine Care?
stayCurious.headlineZh: 新加坡海边有种蓝血“螃蟹”，为什么医药行业需要它？
intro: On Singapore's sandy and muddy shores lives an animal that looks like a small armoured spaceship: the coastal horseshoe crab. It isn't a true crab, and its blood is blue. Even more surprising, a defence system in horseshoe-crab blood helped inspire a safety test used in medicine.
introZh: 在新加坡的沙滩和泥滩上，生活着一种长得像小型装甲飞船的动物：海滨鲎。它虽然叫“蟹”，却不是真正的螃蟹，血液还是蓝色的。更有意思的是，鲎血中的一种防御机制，后来成了医药安全检测的重要工具。

sections.heading: Why is its blood blue?
sections.headingZh: 为什么它的血是蓝色的？
paragraphs: Singapore's National Parks Board identifies the local coastal horseshoe crab as Tachypleus gigas. Horseshoe crabs are more closely related to spiders than to true crabs, and their lineage stretches back hundreds of millions of years. Their blood looks blue because it uses a copper-containing oxygen-carrying protein called hemocyanin. Our red blood, by contrast, gets its colour from iron-containing haemoglobin.
paragraphsZh: 新加坡国家公园局（NParks）介绍，本地的海滨鲎学名是 Tachypleus gigas。鲎和蜘蛛的亲缘关系，比它与真正螃蟹的关系更近；这一类动物的演化历史可追溯到数亿年前。它们的血液之所以呈蓝色，是因为负责运送氧气的血蓝蛋白含有铜。人类的血液则依靠含铁的血红蛋白运氧，所以呈红色。

sections.heading: What makes its blood cells useful to medicine?
sections.headingZh: 医药检测为什么需要它的血细胞？
paragraphs: The blue pigment is not what detects contamination. Certain horseshoe-crab blood cells react to bacterial endotoxins—substances associated with some bacteria—by triggering a clotting response. Scientists developed the Limulus Amebocyte Lysate (LAL) test from this response, based on research on the Atlantic horseshoe crab (Limulus polyphemus). The test's name comes from the animal's genus, Limulus. The test helps manufacturers check medicines and medical products for bacterial endotoxins. That does not mean every blue-blooded horseshoe crab on a Singapore beach is used in that test.
paragraphsZh: 这里有个容易误会的地方：血液是蓝色的，和能检测污染，不是同一个原理。某些鲎的血细胞遇到细菌内毒素，会触发凝结反应。科学家基于对大西洋鲎（Limulus polyphemus）的研究，利用这种反应开发出 LAL 检测法；名称中的 Limulus 就是它所属的属名。这种检测法帮助药品和医疗产品生产商检查细菌内毒素。这不意味着新加坡海边每一只海滨鲎都被拿去做这种检测。

sections.heading: What threatens this ancient animal?
sections.headingZh: 这种古老动物如今面临什么问题？
paragraphs: NParks lists Singapore's coastal horseshoe crab as nationally Endangered, citing habitat loss. The animals also matter to shore ecosystems: their eggs feed birds, fish and other wildlife. In August 2026, the US Food and Drug Administration described a collaborative assessment of a recombinant endotoxin test that does not require horseshoe-crab-derived material. The assessment concerned a manufacturing-change protocol approved in June 2026; it did not mean all pharmaceutical testing had already switched.
paragraphsZh: NParks 将新加坡的海滨鲎列为本地濒危物种，栖息地减少是原因之一。它们的卵还是岸鸟、鱼类等动物的食物。另一方面，医药行业也在寻找不依赖鲎血的替代检测方法。美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）在 2026 年 8 月介绍了一项国际合作评估：一种使用重组试剂的内毒素检测方案，不需要鲎来源的材料。相关生产变更方案已于同年 6 月获批，但这并不等于所有药品检测已经改用新方法。

stayCurious.ending: The next time you see a horseshoe crab on a Singapore shore, you're looking at an ancient animal with a surprisingly modern connection to medicine.
stayCurious.endingZh: 下次在新加坡海边看到鲎，可以多看一眼：它身上藏着一段连接古老生命和现代医药的故事。
